# Packages for the Hyprland desktop stack on Debian/Ubuntu (apt).
# One package per line. Comments with #. Blank lines are ignored.
# Consume with: grep -vE '^\s*(#|$)' deps/packages.apt.txt | xargs sudo apt install -y

# --- Core Hyprland & Wayland Stack ---
hyprland
hyprlock
hypridle
xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland
xdg-desktop-portal-gtk
xdg-desktop-portal-kde
xsettingsd
wlogout

# --- Shell, Panels & Launchers ---
waybar
fuzzel

# --- Audio Stack & Utilities ---
pipewire
pipewire-pulse
pipewire-audio-client-libraries
wireplumber
pamixer
pavucontrol
playerctl
easyeffects
cava
pulseaudio-utils

# --- Screen Capture, Recording & OCR ---
grim
slurp
wf-recorder
tesseract-ocr
tesseract-ocr-eng
imagemagick
ffmpeg

# --- Clipboard, Hardware & Input ---
wl-clipboard
cliphist
ydotool
brightnessctl
ddcutil

# --- System Utilities, Daemons & Keyring ---
polkit-gnome
gnome-keyring
libsecret-tools

gvfs

# --- Wallfliper (Wallpaper Management) ---
python3-pyside6

# --- Python Runtimes & Helper Dependencies ---
python3-pil

# --- Theming, Icons, Cursors & Fonts ---
libgtk-3-0

# Notes:
# - Hyprland: Available in Debian 13 (Trixie)+ and Ubuntu 24.10+. Older versions need a PPA or building from source.
# - quickshell: Not yet packaged in official Debian/Ubuntu repos. Build from source (https://github.com/quickshell-mirror/quickshell).
# - swww, mpvpaper, hyprpicker, hyprshot, matugen: Install via cargo / GitHub releases / PPA.
# - bibata-cursor-theme: Available in Debian Sid/Ubuntu or via GitHub releases.
